verdict.rationale: Stripe is a payments platform and API, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools. Plugging external MCP servers into it so it can call their tools is the MCP-client role, which is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence only shows Stripe acting as an MCP server (mcp.stripe.com, agent plugins for Claude Code/Codex/Cursor). That is the opposite role and does not make this client axis applicable.
